novel_features.name: Local SQLite mirror + FTS5
novel_features.description: Sub-100ms offline full-text search across contacts, matters, notes, comments, and interactions including custom fields.

novel_features.name: Stage bottleneck
novel_features.description: Median matter dwell-time per intake/pipeline stage, surfacing where deals get stuck.

novel_features.name: Cross-matter overdue
novel_features.description: Every past-due task across every matter, grouped by assignee and sorted by lateness.

novel_features.name: Since-window change feed
novel_features.description: Everything created or updated in the last N hours/days across all entities.

novel_features.name: Custom-field report
novel_features.description: Join contacts and matters with arbitrary custom fields and pivot to CSV/JSON.

novel_features.name: Bulk reassign
novel_features.description: Reassign every task matching a filter from one user to another in one command.

novel_features.name: Source velocity
novel_features.description: Rolling conversion rate (prospect to signed matter) per referral source with sparklines.

novel_features.name: Stale intake
novel_features.description: Prospects with zero interactions in N days.

novel_features.name: Who-touched
novel_features.description: Unified chronological feed of every interaction, note, task, and email across all matters for a contact.

novel_features.name: Revenue by source
novel_features.description: Sums invoiced and paid amounts per referral source or practice area.

novel_features.name: Attorney load
novel_features.description: Open matters, overdue tasks, and billable hours MTD per attorney.

novel_features.name: Doctor
novel_features.description: Health check: orphan tasks, contacts with no email, matters in dead stages, custom fields never used, dormant users.

novel_features.name: Webhook bridge
novel_features.description: Local daemon that polls and POSTs entity diffs to a URL of your choice.

novel_features.name: Matter explain
novel_features.description: Markdown brief summarizing a matter from notes, interactions, and tasks.

novel_features.name: Pipeline drift
novel_features.description: Matters that skipped a stage or moved backward through the pipeline.
